headline: INFLATION GAUGE
dek: Prices rose 3.8% in October from a year earlier, up from 3.7% in September, the Commerce Department said.

items.title: ALL PRICES (PCE): 3.8%
items.text: Year over year, up from 3.7% in September. In line with forecasts, per CNBC.

items.title: EXCLUDING FOOD & ENERGY: 3.3%
items.text: Up from 3.1% in September and 0.1 point above the forecast.

items.title: MONTH OVER MONTH: +0.3%
items.text: Down from a 0.5% rise in September, even as gas prices cooled, per AP.

items.title: Q3 ECONOMY: 4.3% GROWTH
items.text: Annualized rate, revised up from 3.4%, the Commerce Department said Wednesday.

means.label: For households:
means.text: Prices are still rising at nearly twice the Fed's 2% target, per CNBC.

means.label: Spending:
means.text: Inflation-adjusted consumer spending was flat in October, BEA data show.

means.label: What's next:
means.text: CNBC reports the data likely seal a Fed rate hike at its next meeting.

sources: Sources: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, Nov. 25; AP, Nov. 25; CNBC, Nov. 25; CNN and Axios on Q3 GDP, Nov. 25.
